blurb: Back 9 Social combines golf simulation using Trackman 4 launch monitors with a gastropub menu and craft cocktails. Guests can play golf in private bays with up to 8 players per bay, enjoy food and drinks, and socialize. The venue also hosts private events and corporate outings with customizable menus and dedicated service options.
extraNote: Closed on Christmas, Thanksgiving, Memorial Day, and the Fourth of July · Pricing is by the bay per hour, not per person · Reservations recommended but walk-ins welcome · Gift cards can be used online for 1 bay reservations but not for deposits on events of 2+ bays · No balloons allowed inside venue · Back 9 Social is not responsible for lost or stolen items
